D.explanation: This makes it more likely that any change in the average duration of vertigo since the introduction of the drug is the result of the drug.

E.explanation: There need not be various significant factors other than the drug that could explain the decrease in the average duration of vertigo since the drug was introduced. One factor would be enough. Furthermore, it’s unknown whether the doctors who believe there has been a reduction in the average duration of vertigo are correct that such a reduction has occurred.
